heading: ## Acceptance Criteria
expected:
- [ ] The exact accepted #1624 head is published without history rewrite and is the source head of one governed pull request targeting `trunk`. <!-- aitm-ac-waived by="audit" reason="remote recovery authority" -->
- [ ] The pull request is merged and authoritative GitHub/git evidence proves the accepted lineage's resulting content is on current remote trunk. <!-- aitm-ac-waived by="audit" reason="remote recovery authority" -->
- [ ] #1624 is reopened and reclosed through the supported delivered-close recovery path without hand-editing historical authority. <!-- aitm-ac-waived by="audit" reason="remote recovery authority" -->
- [ ] Current audit evidence verifies trunk delivery for #1624 and each affected child #1625–#1630. <!-- aitm-ac-waived by="audit" reason="remote recovery authority" -->
replacement:
- [ ] The human-only false-delivery close mode fails closed unless audit, recovery, historical no-commit, same-SHA Test and Review, merged PR, receipt, trunk, worktree, and binding authority all correlate.
- [ ] Immutable correction evidence is written and read back before the completed terminal marker is replaced, and retries resume only the missing saga suffix.
- [ ] The CLI help, command catalog, close rule, and workflow guide distinguish false-delivery recovery from stale, reopened, unauthorized-close, and generic backfill paths.
